custody_posture_qualification.annotation_scope: Added after certification to record the attestation schema and structural posture qualification of the published WORM archives. It changes no certified result, and the published archives (gate-w-8956f505 and prior v4.1.0 fa772122) and their manifests are unchanged.
custody_posture_qualification.note: At certified_git_sha (8956f505) and in the prior v4.1.0 certification (fa772122), EvidenceCustodian emitted cage-evidence-batch/1 attestations, which did not stamp deployment_posture inside the KMS-signed payload. Those archives remain cryptographically sound and verify with citable=true by default in CustodyVerifier without opt-in flags, surfaced structurally with posture_status='unstamped_v1' and citable_qualifications=['unstamped_v1_posture'] rather than defaulting to 'production'. Accepting cage-evidence-batch/1 is cryptographically bounded because schema and deployment_posture sit inside the KMS-signed JCS payload (EVIDENCE_KMS_KEY): relabelling a cage-evidence-batch/2 attestation as cage-evidence-batch/1 or stripping deployment_posture breaks signature verification without the signing key. From cage-evidence-batch/2 onward, EvidenceCustodian stamps deployment_posture ('production' or 'staging') inside every signed attestation, and clean-room Gate W runs (--fresh-project) require posture_status='staging' and citable_qualifications=[].

rating_contamination_audit_2026_11_16.annotation_scope: Added after certification to record the negative contamination audit result for POAM-2026-233 (infrastructure failures signed as policy refusals) and POAM-2026-234 (favourable-error measurement bias in compliance_bridge _is_control_effective_record). rating_contamination_audit_2026_11_16.note: Under POAM-2026-233 and POAM-2026-234, _is_control_effective_record() in src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py counts GOVERNANCE_REFUSAL, GOVERNANCE_REFUSAL_RECEIPT, GOVERNANCE_DEFERRAL (including unpersisted DeferQueue failures), and INFERENCE_PROXY_BLOCK (including fail-closed quarantine Redis errors) as control effectiveness in safety_rate, so an OPA or Redis outage can raise measured posture. Recomputing per-control safety_rate across all three published Gate W WORM archives with every refusal, deferral, refusal-receipt, and quarantine-block record excluded yields 1.0000 across all six evaluated controls (A.5.2, A.5.3, A.8.4, A.9.2, SC-4, AC-3) with 0 OPA-outage refusals. Published Gate W certification ratings, Lula Active ratings, and the OSCAL evidence claim census were not contaminated; the structural defects remain open under POAM-2026-233 and POAM-2026-234.
